decision: REWORK is required because both submitted compositions replace Giulia's established mature appearance with a substantially younger-looking, dark-haired woman who resembles Nika. The approved reference establishes Giulia at approximately 49 years old, with visible silver strands and mature facial features. Neither submitted composition preserves those defining characteristics. Both submitted images otherwise communicate the operational rehearsal: Nika directs activity, Matteo works near the refrigeration equipment, and the apron-wearing woman handles plated desserts in the service corridor. The location, three-person staging and essential service action remain understandable. The historically accepted compositions demonstrate that the same scene can preserve Giulia's recognizable age, silver-streaked hair and mature facial structure without sacrificing operational clarity. The blocking defect is therefore character identity continuity, not action legibility, composition or the absence of a minor narrated gesture. The supplied evidence does not include separate dialogue text or a dialogue-overlay capture, so no independent claim about dialogue or UI readability is made. Targeted correction of Giulia in both submitted compositions is warranted; complete scene regeneration is not established as necessary.

findings.playerImpact: The player encounters a woman who does not visually correspond to established Giulia. Because Nika is also present and the two women appear similar in age and facial characteristics, the image can suggest an additional younger kitchen worker rather than Giulia participating in the rehearsal. This materially disrupts character recognition and continuity despite the service action remaining understandable.

visualEvidence.observation: The approved character sheet presents Giulia in full-body, frontal close-up and side-profile views. She has dark brown hair with prominent silver strands concentrated around the hairline and temples, pulled into a loose low bun. Her face has visible forehead lines, mature eye contours, defined cheek and nasolabial folds, and subtle skin texture consistent with a woman approximately 49 years old. She wears a muted sage-green collared shirt, a light beige waist apron, dark trousers and black shoes. Small gold hoop earrings are visible.

The portrait composition shows Nika on the left wearing an olive blazer and pointing while holding a document, Matteo in the middle leaning toward an open refrigerator, and an apron-wearing woman on the right carrying a tray of small desserts topped with berries. The woman occupying Giulia's position has dark brown hair gathered into a loose bun, smooth youthful facial contours and no clearly identifiable silver strands. Her appearance is substantially younger than the approved Giulia and resembles the young brunette Nika. She wears a white double-breasted chef-style jacket rather than the specified cream collared shirt, together with an olive apron and dark trousers. The refrigeration equipment, desserts and directional gesture clearly establish active service coordination.

The landscape composition places Matteo on the left removing or handling a dessert tray at an open refrigerator, Nika in the center pointing toward him while holding paperwork, and an apron-wearing woman on the right carrying plated desserts through the service corridor. The woman intended as Giulia again appears youthful, with smooth facial features and predominantly dark brown hair without the reference character's prominent silver strands. Her face and hairstyle closely resemble Nika's, making the two women appear similar in age. She wears a white chef-style jacket and olive apron. All three figures and their operational activities are clearly visible, but Giulia's established age and facial identity are not preserved.

The historical portrait shows Nika on the left pointing into the corridor while holding a clipboard, Matteo behind her near an open refrigerator, and Giulia on the right carrying a metal tray of individual layered desserts. Giulia has a visibly mature face, defined eye and cheek contours, and dark hair interspersed with substantial gray and silver strands, particularly around the front and crown. Her hair is pulled back loosely. She wears a cream-white collared shirt, faded-olive apron and dark trousers. Her appearance is recognizably consistent with the approved reference while the coordinated service activity remains legible.

The historical landscape presents Nika on the left pointing down the service corridor while holding an open notebook, Matteo in the center handling a metal container beside open refrigeration equipment, and Giulia on the right holding a tray of berry-topped desserts and paperwork. Giulia has visible silver-gray streaks throughout her dark hair, a loosely gathered bun, mature facial proportions and age-related texture around her eyes and cheeks. She is clearly distinguishable from the younger Nika. Her cream collared shirt, faded-olive apron and dark trousers match the required wardrobe. The composition establishes the same kitchen-service environment and coordinated operational activity as the submitted landscape.
